propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches against transition names but callers pass destination status names, causing silent resolution failures on workflows where these differ
the lookup misses and raises ValueError which is caught and soft-failed into bridge_alerts, allowing the pass to exit 0 without applying the status change
some statuses sync while others silently fail, creating partial bridge behavior rather than exposing a clear mapping defect
transition_issue_by_name must resolve requested names against both transition names (exact match preferred) and destination status names (to.name field)
ambiguous destinations with multiple transitions to the same status must raise an error rather than silently selecting one
error messages must list both available transition names and their destination statuses for clarity
